items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: I got an offer from one of these leaders to come to St. Louis, to play. Because he had had an argument with the piano player, his name was Cecil Scott

ctx.x: And of course the musicians who played music were fortunate enough to make a little money, have fun. And this is really what music was about, as far as jazz music was concerned, during that period. And it was, as I said, through meeting these musicians, coming through Cape (crossed out) Granby Jurado, Missouri, while in the CCC Camp, that I got an offer from one of these leaders to come to St. Louis, to play. Because he had had an argument with the piano player, his name was Cecil Scott, and he was a famous --…
